engineeringSkip.reason: Chronon modulation — treating time as discrete, engineerable units and using exotic matter to build quantum closed timelike curves for retrieving information from the future — has no basis in known physics and no credible research programme behind it.

factCheck.reason: There is no such thing as a manipulable 'chronon' unit of time, and no known physics lets exotic matter be used to alter entropy flow or pull information from future states.
